title: The AUS-PREDICT Registry for DCIS Patients With DCISionRT Testing

rules.rule_text: A clinical decision has been made to order the DCISionRT Test as part of routine patient care
rules.source_text: A clinical decision has been made to order the DCISionRT™ Test as part of routine patient care

rules.rule_text: Histologically confirmed ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) in a single breast (LCIS or other benign disease allowed)
rules.source_text: Patient must have histologically confirmed ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) in a single breast (presence of lobular carcinoma in situ (LCIS) or other benign breast disease in addition to DCIS is acceptable)

rules.rule_text: Patient must be consented within 120 days after surgery
rules.source_text: Patient must be consented within 120 days after surgery
rules.applies_if: applies if surgery has been performed (criterion references 'after surgery')
rules.notes: Criterion wording implies application relative to surgery date; ambiguous if patient has not yet had surgery.

rules.rule_text: Eligible for, or have already received, breast conserving surgery
rules.source_text: Patient must be eligible for, or have already received breast conserving surgery

rules.rule_text: Eligible to receive radiation and/or systemic treatment
rules.source_text: Patient must be eligible to receive radiation and/or systemic treatment

rules.rule_text: Patient is female
rules.source_text: Patient must be female and greater than 25 years old

rules.rule_text: Patient age is greater than 25 years
rules.source_text: Patient must be female and greater than 25 years old
rules.notes: Trial header lists Minimum Age: 26 Years; inclusion text states 'greater than 25 years'. These are equivalent but wording retained from inclusion text.

rules.rule_text: Patient must be able to provide informed consent
rules.source_text: Patient must be able to provide informed consent

rules.rule_text: Patient tissue is insufficient to generate DCISionRT test results
rules.source_text: Patient tissue is insufficient to generate DCISionRT test results or required DCISionRT inputs (age, tumor size, margin status, palpability) are missing
rules.notes: Part of a combined exclusion that also lists missing required inputs; preserved original phrasing.

rules.rule_text: Required DCISionRT input 'age' is missing
rules.source_text: Patient tissue is insufficient to generate DCISionRT test results or required DCISionRT inputs (age, tumor size, margin status, palpability) are missing
rules.notes: Input absence treated as exclusion per text listing; input names preserved exactly.

rules.rule_text: Required DCISionRT input 'tumor size' is missing
rules.source_text: Patient tissue is insufficient to generate DCISionRT test results or required DCISionRT inputs (age, tumor size, margin status, palpability) are missing

rules.rule_text: Patient has invasive breast cancer
rules.source_text: Patient has invasive breast cancer or evidence in the ipsilateral or contralateral breast of invasive breast cancer, including microinvasion, lymph node involvement, or Paget's disease of the nipple

rules.rule_text: Evidence of invasive breast cancer in the ipsilateral or contralateral breast
rules.source_text: Patient has invasive breast cancer or evidence in the ipsilateral or contralateral breast of invasive breast cancer, including microinvasion, lymph node involvement, or Paget's disease of the nipple
rules.notes: This captures the phrase 'evidence in the ipsilateral or contralateral breast' from the same sentence; related to invasive disease.
